## Genome instability

```{r instability-setup}
# SECTION_DATA$shatterseek (R/sections/shatterseek.R) and SECTION_DATA$ecdna (R/sections/ecdna.R).
# Both parse to list(status = "not_run") when nothing was found; NULL is treated the same.
ss = SECTION_DATA[["shatterseek"]]
ec = SECTION_DATA[["ecdna"]]
ss_ok = !is.null(ss) && identical(ss$status, "ok")
ec_status = if (is.null(ec) || is.null(ec$status)) "not_run" else ec$status
# Amplicons were found and classified, and none is ecDNA or BFB: a negative screen
ec_neg = ec_status == "detected" && !is.null(ec$amplicons) && nrow(ec$amplicons) > 0 &&
         !isTRUE(ec$n_ecdna > 0) && !isTRUE(ec$n_bfb > 0)

inst_int = function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "–", formatC(as.numeric(x), format = "d", big.mark = ","))
inst_num = function(x, digits = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "–", formatC(as.numeric(x), format = "f", digits = digits))
inst_span = function(chrom, start, end) {
  ifelse(is.na(start) | is.na(end), "–",
         paste0(chrom, ":", formatC(as.numeric(start), format = "d", big.mark = ","), "–",
                formatC(as.numeric(end), format = "d", big.mark = ",")))
}
inst_verdict = function(text, kind) tags$p(class = paste0("instability-verdict instability-verdict--", kind), text)
inst_html = function(tag) cat("\n```{=html}\n", as.character(tag), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
# Path relative to the sample directory, for provenance lines
inst_rel = function(p) {
  root = sub("/+$", "", as.character(sample_dir))
  ifelse(startsWith(p, paste0(root, "/")), substring(p, nchar(root) + 2L), p)
}
```

### Chromothripsis

```{r shatterseek-verdict}
if (!ss_ok) {
  section_notice("ShatterSeek was not run for this sample (no shatterseek/<combination>/*.shatterseek.tsv found).")
} else {
  inst_verdict(shatterseek_verdict(ss), if (nrow(ss$high) > 0) "positive" else "negative")
}
```

```{r shatterseek-calls, results='asis', eval=ss_ok && nrow(ss$high) > 0}
# Every call of every caller combination in one table, a row per (chromosome, combination),
# grouped by chromosome. No call anywhere: the verdict above is the whole result (no table,
# no per-combination repetition of the same negative)
multi = length(ss$combos) > 1
chrom_rank = match(ss$high$chrom, chromosomes_for_sex("male"))
chrom_rank[is.na(chrom_rank)] = 999L
h = ss$high[order(chrom_rank, match(ss$high$combo, names(ss$combos)))]
silent = setdiff(names(ss$combos), unique(h$combo))

if (shatterseek_disagree(ss)) {
  inst_html(section_notice(paste(
    "The caller combinations disagree. A call made with only one copy-number or SV source is",
    "less robust than one every combination supports; compare the rows below."), warn = TRUE))
}
inst_html(htmltools::tagList(
  tags$div(class = "instability-scroll",
    tags$table(class = "instability-table",
      tags$thead(tags$tr(lapply(c("Chromosome", if (multi) "Combination", "Confidence", "Tiers met",
                                  "Cluster span", "Intra-chr SVs", "Translocations",
                                  "Oscillating CN segments"), tags$th))),
      tags$tbody(lapply(seq_len(nrow(h)), function(i) tags$tr(
        tags$td(class = "instability-table__key", h$chrom[i]),
        if (multi) tags$td(ss$labels[[h$combo[i]]]),
        tags$td(tags$span(class = paste0("instability-pill instability-pill--",
                                         if (h$confidence[i] == "high") "high" else "other"),
                          h$confidence[i])),
        tags$td(if (nzchar(h$criteria[i])) h$criteria[i] else "–"),
        tags$td(class = "instability-table__num", inst_span(h$chrom[i], h$start[i], h$end[i])),
        tags$td(class = "instability-table__num", inst_int(h$n_sv[i])),
        tags$td(class = "instability-table__num", inst_int(h$n_tra[i])),
        tags$td(class = "instability-table__num", inst_int(h$n_oscillating[i]))
      )))
    )
  ),
  if (multi && length(silent))
    tags$p(class = "table-footnote",
           paste0("No chromothripsis called by ",
                  paste(vapply(silent, function(cb)
                          paste0(ss$labels[[cb]], if (nrow(ss$combos[[cb]]) == 0) " (empty output: nothing tested)" else ""),
                          character(1)), collapse = ", "),
                  "."))
))
```

```{r shatterseek-all-open, results='asis', eval=ss_ok}
cat('::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="All chromosomes (ShatterSeek summary)"}\n\n')
```

```{r shatterseek-all, eval=ss_ok}
ss_all = rbindlist(lapply(names(ss$combos), function(cb) {
  d = copy(ss$combos[[cb]])
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
  d[, combination := ss$labels[[cb]]]
}), fill = TRUE)
if (nrow(ss_all) > 0) {
  keep = c("combination", "chrom", "confidence", "criteria", "start", "end", "n_sv", "n_del", "n_dup",
           "n_h2hinv", "n_t2tinv", "n_tra", "n_sv_incl_tra", "n_oscillating",
           "q_fragment_joins", "q_chr_enrichment", "q_exp_chr", "q_exp_cluster")
  keep = keep[keep %in% names(ss_all)]
  ss_all = ss_all[, ..keep]
  for (k in grep("^q_", keep, value = TRUE)) set(ss_all, j = k, value = signif(ss_all[[k]], 3))
  setnames(ss_all,
           c("chrom", "n_sv", "n_del", "n_dup", "n_h2hinv", "n_t2tinv", "n_tra", "n_sv_incl_tra", "n_oscillating"),
           c("chromosome", "intra SVs", "DEL", "DUP", "h2hINV", "t2tINV", "TRA", "SVs incl. TRA", "oscillating CN (2 states)"),
           skip_absent = TRUE)
  DT::datatable(
    ss_all,
    rownames   = FALSE,
    filter     = "top",
    extensions = c("Buttons"),
    options    = list(
      dom        = "Bfrtip",
      buttons    = c("copy", "csv"),
      scrollX    = TRUE,
      pageLength = 23,
      columnDefs = list(list(className = "dt-left", targets = "_all"))
    )
  )
} else {
  section_notice("ShatterSeek output is empty.")
}
```

```{r shatterseek-all-close, results='asis', eval=ss_ok}
cat("\n:::\n\n")
```

```{r shatterseek-details, eval=ss_ok}
table_details(
  summary = "Tiers and caveats",
  tags$p("ShatterSeek (Cortes-Ciriano et al. 2020; PCAWG-corrected CHM13 fork) tests, per chromosome,",
         "the largest cluster of interleaved intra-chromosomal SVs against the hallmarks of chromothripsis.",
         "A chromosome is called ", tags$strong("high"), " confidence when it meets any PCAWG high-confidence tier",
         "(significance at BH q ≤ 0.2 across the sample's chromosomes; NA counts as a fail):"),
  tags$ul(
    tags$li(tags$strong("HC1"), ": ≥ 6 interleaved intra-chromosomal SVs, ≥ 7 adjacent segments oscillating between",
            "two copy-number states, fragment joins not significant (random joins), and breakpoints enriched on the",
            "chromosome or clustered (exponential test)."),
    tags$li(tags$strong("HC2"), ": ≥ 3 interleaved intra-chromosomal SVs, ≥ 4 translocations, ≥ 7 oscillating segments,",
            "fragment joins not significant."),
    tags$li(tags$strong("HC3"), ": ≥ 40 SVs including translocations, fragment joins not significant.",
            "PCAWG applied HC3 only to osteo-, leiomyo- and liposarcomas; here it applies to every tumour.")
  ),
  tags$p("PCAWG's low-confidence tier (4–6 oscillating segments) is not reported. Caveats:"),
  tags$ul(
    tags$li("The cut-offs were set on PCAWG short-read calls. Long-read callers report many small SVs;",
            "intra-chromosomal SVs shorter than --shatterseek_min_svlen (default 150 bp) are excluded."),
    tags$li("Centromeres and satellite arrays are not masked: a cluster spanning a centromere or heterochromatin",
            "block (e.g. chr1q12, chr9q12, chr16q11.2) is more likely a mapping artefact than chromothripsis —",
            "check the ShatterSeek figure (shatterseek/<combination>/plots/)."),
    tags$li("Multiple-testing correction covers 23 chromosomes of one sample, not a cohort as in PCAWG."),
    tags$li("Tumour-only Severus calls include germline SVs the panel of normals did not remove."),
    tags$li("Insertions, single breakends and SVs touching chrY, chrM or unplaced contigs are not used;",
            "copy number is rounded to integers.")
  ),
  tags$p("Source: ", lapply(names(ss$files), function(cb)
    tags$span(tags$code(inst_rel(ss$files[[cb]])), " (", ss$labels[[cb]], ") ")))
)
```

### Extrachromosomal DNA (ecDNA) and focal amplicons

```{r ecdna-verdict}
if (ec_status == "not_run") {
  section_notice("ecDNA analysis (CoRAL / AmpliconClassifier) was not run for this sample (no ecdna/ output found).")
} else {
  inst_verdict(ecdna_verdict(ec), switch(ec_status,
    detected      = if (isTRUE(ec$n_ecdna > 0) || isTRUE(ec$n_bfb > 0)) "positive" else "neutral",
    unclassified  = "unknown",
    "negative"))
}
```

```{r ecdna-details-open, results='asis', eval=ec_neg}
# Negative screen (amplicons found, none ecDNA or BFB): the verdict above is the result; the
# amplicon table and CoRAL plots are kept, collapsed
cat(sprintf('::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Amplicon details (%d amplicon%s, not ecDNA or BFB)"}\n\n',
            nrow(ec$amplicons), if (nrow(ec$amplicons) == 1) "" else "s"))
```

```{r ecdna-amplicons, results='asis', eval=ec_status %in% c("detected", "unclassified") && nrow(ec$amplicons) > 0}
# results='asis' + inst_html(): raw HTML, so it survives inside the callout fence above
a = ec$amplicons
flag = function(v) {
  if (is.na(v)) tags$span(class = "instability-muted", "–")
  else if (v) tags$span(class = "instability-pill instability-pill--high", "yes")
  else tags$span(class = "instability-muted", "no")
}
inst_html(tags$div(class = "instability-scroll",
  tags$table(class = "instability-table",
    tags$thead(tags$tr(lapply(c("Amplicon", "Class", "ecDNA+", "BFB+", "Location", "Oncogenes",
                                "Max CN", "Size"), tags$th))),
    tags$tbody(lapply(seq_len(nrow(a)), function(i) tags$tr(
      tags$td(class = "instability-table__key", paste0("amplicon", a$amplicon[i])),
      tags$td(if (is.na(a$class[i])) tags$span(class = "instability-muted", "not classified") else a$class[i]),
      tags$td(flag(a$ecdna[i])),
      tags$td(flag(a$bfb[i])),
      tags$td(class = "instability-table__loc",
              if (is.na(a$location[i])) "–" else gsub(", ", "\n", a$location[i], fixed = TRUE)),
      tags$td(class = "instability-table__genes", if (is.na(a$oncogenes[i])) "–" else a$oncogenes[i]),
      tags$td(class = "instability-table__num", inst_num(a$max_cn[i])),
      tags$td(class = "instability-table__num", if (is.na(a$size_bp[i])) "–" else fmt_bp(a$size_bp[i]))
    )))
  )
))
```

```{r ecdna-plots, results='asis', eval=ec_status != "not_run" && length(ec$plots) > 0}
# CoRAL's per-amplicon plots; slim reports embed the first six and name the folder with the rest
ec_plots = ec$plots
ec_cap = if (identical(embed, "full")) length(ec_plots) else min(6L, length(ec_plots))
shown = ec_plots[seq_len(ec_cap)]
plot_caption = function(p) {
  n = sub(".*_amplicon([0-9]+)_(graph|cycles)\\.png$", "\\1", basename(p))
  kind = if (grepl("_graph\\.png$", p)) "breakpoint graph and copy number" else "decomposed cycles / paths"
  paste0("Amplicon ", n, ": ", kind, " (CoRAL)")
}
inst_html(htmltools::tagList(
  tags$div(class = "instability-plots",
    lapply(shown, function(p) embed_png(p, max_width = "100%", caption = plot_caption(p)))),
  if (length(ec_plots) > ec_cap)
    tags$p(class = "table-footnote",
           sprintf("%d more CoRAL plot%s not embedded (--embed slim); see ", length(ec_plots) - ec_cap,
                   if (length(ec_plots) - ec_cap == 1) "" else "s"),
           tags$code(paste(unique(dirname(ec_plots[-seq_len(ec_cap)])), collapse = ", ")), ".")
))
```

```{r ecdna-details-close, results='asis', eval=ec_neg}
cat("\n:::\n\n")
```

```{r ecdna-genes, eval=ec_status == "detected" && nrow(ec$genes) > 0}
g = copy(ec$genes)
g[, amplicon := ifelse(is.na(amplicon), NA_character_, paste0("amplicon", amplicon))]
g[, gene_cn := round(gene_cn, 1)]
setnames(g, c("gene_cn", "oncogene"), c("gene CN", "canonical oncogene"))
DT::datatable(
  g,
  rownames   = FALSE,
  filter     = "top",
  extensions = c("Buttons"),

                    columnDefs = list(list(className = "dt-left", targets = "_all")))
)
```

```{r ecdna-genes-close, results='asis', eval=ec_status == "detected" && nrow(ec$genes) > 0}

```

```{r ecdna-details, eval=ec_status != "not_run"}
table_details(
  summary = "Method and caveats",
  tags$p("CoRAL reconstructs amplicon structures from the tumour long reads, seeded by ASCAT copy-number",
         "segments above --coral_gain; AmpliconClassifier then labels each amplicon (ecDNA, BFB, complex",
         paste0("non-cyclic, linear). Amplicons classified \"No amp/Invalid\" are not listed",
                if (isTRUE(ec$n_invalid > 0)) sprintf(" (%d here)", ec$n_invalid), ".")),
  tags$ul(
    tags$li("An empty CoRAL seed file means no segment exceeded the gain threshold, so nothing was reconstructed —",
            "a negative screen at that threshold, not proof of absence."),
    tags$li("Without AmpliconClassifier output (e.g. a CHM13 run without --aa_data_repo, or",
            "--skip_ampliconclassifier) amplicons are listed from CoRAL's summary and ecDNA status is unknown;",
            "their Max CN is the copy count of CoRAL's heaviest cycle or path, not a segment copy number."),
    tags$li("ecDNA and BFB calls are computational predictions from read-level breakpoint graphs; confirm",
            "clinically relevant amplifications orthogonally (e.g. FISH) before acting on them.")
  ),
  tags$p("Source: ", lapply(unname(ec$files), function(p) tags$span(tags$code(inst_rel(p)), " ")))
)
```
